NONE: › a long, angry speech expressing strong disapproval

example: She launched into an angry/furious tirade about how she had been unfairly treated.
她就自己遭受的不公正對待，進行了長時間的憤怒控訴。
In a furious tirade of abuse, the opposition spokesperson demanded the minister's resignation.
在措詞激烈的長篇指責中，反對黨發言人要求這位部長辭職。

NONE: › a sweet, cold Italian dish, consisting of soft cheese, cake, coffee, and sometimes alcohol
提拉米蘇（一種義大利冷甜點，由軟乾酪、蛋糕、酒和咖啡製成）
C2 to begin to feel as if you have no energy and want to rest or go to sleep, or to make someone feel this way

example: She's been leading throughout the race, but it now looks as if she's tiring.
她在整個賽跑中一路領先，但現在看上去似乎累了。
Even walking up the stairs at work tires me these days.
最近，我連上班時上樓梯都感到累。

NONE: C2 to become bored with someone or something, or to stop enjoying an activity

example: This is the kind of toy that kids will soon tire of.
這種玩具小孩會很快玩膩的。
He never tires of (= he enjoys) playing games on his computer.
電腦遊戲他百玩不厭。

NONE: › to make someone feel very tired

example: Let the kids run around outside - that'll tire them out.
讓孩子在院子裡跑跑吧，他們很快就會筋疲力盡的。

NONE: A1 in need of rest or sleep
› disapproving used to describe people, ideas, or subjects that are not interesting because they are very familiar
（人、想法或話題）老套乏味的，令人生厭的
B1 to be bored with an activity or person

example: I was so tired when I got home from work last night that I had a quick nap.
我昨晚下班回家後很累，就小睡了一會兒。
My legs are tired.
我的腿酸了。
She spoke in a tired voice.
她說話有氣無力的。
It's always the same tired old faces at these meetings.
在這些會上總是些不變的令人生厭的老面孔。
I'm so tired of doing the same job, day after day.
我厭倦了日復一日地做同樣的工作。
Don't you get tired of arguing all the time?
老吵架你們不覺得累嗎？
I'm sick and tired of you telling me what to do all the time.
我很煩你老是對我該做甚麼指手畫腳。

NONE: › very much in need of rest or sleep

example: We were all really tired out after our long journey.
在這番長途旅行之後，我們全都疲憊不堪。

NONE: 不知疲倦的，不覺疲勞的

example: Tony is a tireless worker.
托尼工作起來不知疲倦。
The prisoner's family is conducting a tireless campaign for his release.
這個囚犯的家人為了他能獲釋，正在不懈地進行活動。
The police have been tireless in their search for the child's killer.
警方一直不懈地搜尋殺害這個孩子的兇手。

NONE: C2 annoying and making you lose patience
令人厭倦的；使人不耐煩的

example: I find it very tiresome doing the same job day after day.
我覺得日復一日地做同樣的工作令人非常厭煩。
He has the tiresome habit of finishing your sentences for you.
他喜歡接別人還沒說完的話，這個習慣很叫人討厭。
I've had a very tiring day.
我這一天過得很累。
Looking after the kids is extremely tiring.
照顧小孩非常累人。
